## Summary

The root cause: InboxZap pivoted from an old product ("Lumina," an AI meeting assistant), but the pivot was only half-finished. The `<title>` metadata said InboxZap, but the homepage, nav, footer, and structured data still described Lumina — and the blog's 12 posts, which are already well-targeted to real queries from the GSC export (`gmail storage full` · 790 impressions, `how to reach inbox zero` · 1,180, `unsubscribe from newsletters` · 560), were stuck at positions 40–60 with near-zero clicks because the blog index fetched from a `/api/posts` route that never existed — every post was an orphan, unlinked and missing from the sitemap.

**Shipped (repo builds clean, `npm run build` verified):**
- Rebuilt `/blog` and all 12 posts as server-rendered pages with titles, meta descriptions, canonicals, and Article JSON-LD — all now in `app/sitemap.ts` for the first time.
- Finished the brand pivot across homepage, nav, footer, and site-wide JSON-LD (Organization + SoftwareApplication).
- Built real `/features`, `/pricing`, `/faq` pages (FAQ has FAQPage JSON-LD) to replace dead nav links and a `/faq → #faq` redirect pointing at a section that didn't exist.
- Split two posts that had been competing for the same "bulk delete emails" query.
- Set up `seo/` state (context, keyword map built from `gsc/Queries.csv`, backlog, log, first report) per the seo-autopilot skill.

**Open items for you** (in `seo/backlog.md` and `seo/reports/2026-10-14.md`): no OG image file has ever existed in `public/`, so social previews are blank; three queries (`clean up inbox`, `inbox cleaner free`, `declutter email inbox`) have no dedicated page yet; and whether a paid/team tier exists needs confirming before `/pricing` says more than "free."
